details.ret_named_exact: Payroll takes {ret_missing} a month pre-tax for retirement; the census does not carry that retirement amount.
details.ret_part_carried: The census is short {ret_missing} a month of the pre-tax deduction payroll takes. The payslip names {ret_named} a month as retirement.
details.ret_named_plus: Payroll reduces federal wages by {ret_missing} a month more than the census carries. The payslip names {ret_named} of it as retirement and does not name the other {ret_unnamed}.
details.ret_unnamed: Payroll takes a pre-tax deduction of {ret_missing} a month that the payslip does not name and the census does not carry.
details.pretax_missing: The proposal starts from {ti_gap_abs} a month more income than the payslip taxes; the census does not carry a matching pre-tax deduction.
details.wrong_column: The census carries {ti_gap_abs} a month of retirement in the Other pre-tax column, which also cuts Social Security and Medicare wages; payroll leaves retirement inside those wages.
details.ti_neg: The proposal starts from {ti_gap_abs} a month less income than the payslip taxes; the census pre-tax amount is higher by {ti_gap_abs} a month.
details.census_missing: No census row carries this employee's payroll number or name.
details.ss_on: The report counts {eng_ss} a month of Social Security savings and neither payslip deducts Social Security.
details.ss_off: Both payslips deduct Social Security and the report counts no saving on it; the payslips show {pay_ss_sav} a month attributable to that deduction.
details.med_on: The report counts {eng_med} a month of Medicare savings and neither payslip deducts Medicare.
details.med_off: Both payslips deduct Medicare and the report counts no saving on it; the payslips show {pay_med_sav} a month attributable to that deduction.
details.fee_mismatch: The report worked the allotment out with a {fee_eng} monthly fee and payroll deducts {fee_pay}. The difference lands in the allotment every month.
details.salary_zero: The proposal calculated this employee on zero income; the census carries {census_gross} of annual pay.
details.premium_mismatch: The payslip deducts {premium_m} a month and the report uses a different premium amount.
details.premium_not_pretax: Of the {premium_m} premium, {premium_stayed_taxable} a month stayed inside federal taxable wages.
details.premium_not_medicare: Of the {premium_m} premium, {premium_stayed_medicare} a month stayed inside Medicare wages.
details.reimb_missing: The payslip deducts a {premium_m} monthly premium and shows no reimbursement for that premium.
details.reimb_partial: The payslip shows a {premium_m} premium and a reimbursement {reimb_short} a month lower.
details.ret_changed: The retirement deduction changed by {ret_change_size} a month between the two payslips.
details.fixed_fed: Federal tax withheld is {fed_before_m} a month on both payslips.
details.fed_zero: The payslip shows {fed_before_m} a month of federal withholding; the report promises {eng_fed_sav} a month of federal saving.
details.w4_diff: Payroll and the census hold different W-4 details: {w4_text}.
details.gross_moved: Gross pay changed by {gross_moved_abs} a month between the two payslips.
details.identity_fee_stmt: The payslip figures are out by {identity_gap} a month: tax saved less the fee does not equal the take home change.
details.identity_fee_prop: The payslip figures are out by {identity_gap} a month, with the fee taken from the report because the payslip prints none.
details.report_internal: The report's own arithmetic is out by {report_int_gap} a month: gross savings less the fee does not equal the allotment it promises.
details.fed_mismatch: Payroll saved {pay_fed_sav} a month of federal tax and the report promises {eng_fed_sav}, leaving {fed_residual_abs} a month the corrections above do not account for.
details.census_ss_not_n: Neither payslip deducts Social Security and the census does not carry N for this employee.
details.census_ss_not_y: Both payslips deduct Social Security and the census carries N for this employee.
details.census_med_not_n: Neither payslip deducts Medicare and the census does not carry N for this employee.
details.state_generic: Payroll saved {pay_state_sav} a month of state tax and the report promises {eng_state_sav}, leaving {state_residual_abs} a month the corrections above do not account for.
details.fica: Payroll saved {pay_fica_sav} a month of Social Security and Medicare and the report promises {eng_fica_sav}, leaving {fica_residual_abs} a month the corrections above do not account for.
details.taxable_fell_extra: Federal taxable wages fell {taxable_fell_extra} a month more than the {premium_m} premium.
details.medicare_fell_extra: Medicare wages fell {medicare_fell_extra} a month more than the {premium_m} premium.
details.reimb_over: The payslip shows a {premium_m} premium and a reimbursement {reimb_over} a month higher.

actions.ret_named_exact: Put {ret_missing} a month in the census 401-k/IRA column.
actions.ret_named_plus: Put {ret_named} a month in the census 401-k/IRA column. Ask payroll what the other {ret_unnamed} a month pre-tax deduction is before adding it to the census.
actions.ret_part_carried: Increase the census 401-k/IRA column by {ret_missing} a month.
actions.ret_unnamed: Ask payroll what the {ret_missing} a month pre-tax deduction is, then add it to the census in the column that matches.
actions.pretax_missing: Ask payroll which pre-tax deduction accounts for {ti_gap_abs} a month, then add it to the census.
actions.wrong_column: Move the retirement amount from the census Other pre-tax column to the 401-k/IRA column.
actions.ti_neg: Reduce the census pre-tax fields by {ti_gap_abs} a month to match the payslip.
actions.census_missing: Add this employee to the census.
actions.ss_on: Set the census SocialSec column to N.
actions.census_ss_not_n: Set the census SocialSec column to N.
actions.census_ss_not_y: Set the census SocialSec column to Y.
actions.ss_off: Set the census SocialSec column to Y.
actions.census_med_not_n: Set the census Medicare column to N.
actions.med_on: Set the census Medicare column to N.
actions.med_off: Set the census Medicare column to Y.
actions.fee_mismatch: Set the employee fee in the proposal program settings to {fee_pay} a month.
actions.salary_zero: Set the buffer in the proposal program settings to 100.
actions.premium_mismatch: Set the premium in the proposal program settings to {premium_m} a month.
actions.premium_not_pretax: Payroll must take the whole premium pre-tax.
actions.taxable_fell_extra: Ask payroll for a mock in which only the premium changes.
actions.premium_not_medicare: Payroll must take the whole premium out of Medicare wages.
actions.medicare_fell_extra: Ask payroll for a mock in which only the premium changes.
actions.reimb_missing: Payroll must add the reimbursement line.
actions.reimb_partial: Payroll must set the reimbursement to {premium_m} a month.
actions.reimb_over: Payroll must set the reimbursement to {premium_m} a month.
actions.ret_changed: Ask payroll for a mock in which only the premium changes.
actions.fixed_fed: Ask payroll why federal withholding did not move.
actions.fed_zero: Reduce the promised federal saving to {fed_before_m} a month.
actions.w4_diff: Correct the census W-4 columns to match payroll.
actions.gross_moved: Ask payroll for a mock in which only the premium changes.
actions.identity_fee_stmt: Ask payroll for a clean copy of both payslips.
actions.identity_fee_prop: Ask payroll for a clean copy of both payslips.
actions.fed_mismatch: Check the census W-4 details and additional federal withholding against the payslip; if they match, payroll must account for the remaining {fed_residual_abs} a month.
actions.state_generic: Check the census state marital status and withholding dependents against the payslip.
actions.fica: Check the census pay frequency against the payslip.
